digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler integration test fixtures and ADF codec
propositions: Integration fixture test_reconcile_roundtrip._load_module unconditionally replaces sys.modules canonical ADF key, installing module B while AdfCodec retains binding to prior module A, causing codec to call A but monkeypatched test modifies B
Serial test ordering failure occurs only after round-trip integration fixture runs; isolated unit runs pass, indicating cross-test state pollution via shared module identity
By-path loader must cache and return existing module when both canonical name and __file__ source match to preserve caller-invariant module identity across test execution order
Runtime identity instrumentation confirmed codec output follows only the cached module A, with monkeypatch of B having no effect on codec.to_wire() result
